name: bannor_horseman
description: a Bannor Horseman, a crusader cavalryman in a steel kettle helmet over brown hair, a steel mail shirt and shoulder plates under a white tabard with red trim and a gold sun, a round red shield with a gold sun and a steel rim on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped wooden spear raised in his LEFT hand, riding a chestnut horse with a white blaze, a dark brown mane and tail and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round red shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
